title: Fire & Smoke Mitigation Deodorization and Air-Cleaning Equipment Rate Card
content:
This rate card lists the daily rates of the three kinds of deodorization and air-cleaning equipment used on Fire & Smoke Mitigation jobs, the number of equipment days billable on one job, and the ozone occupancy setting, for every tier.

## Items

- HEPA air scrubber: HEPA air scrubber per unit per billable day, USD.
- Hydroxyl generator: Hydroxyl generator per unit per billable day, USD.
- Ozone generator: Ozone generator per unit per billable day, USD.
- Ozone while occupied: Whether ozone may be used while the structure is occupied (it never may; ozone runs only in a vacated structure), boolean.
- Billable equipment day cap: Deodorization and air-cleaning equipment days billable per job, count of calendar days.

## Rates by tier

| Tier | Air scrubber per unit-day (USD) | Hydroxyl generator per unit-day (USD) | Ozone generator per unit-day (USD) | Ozone while occupied | Billable equipment day cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smoke Odor Response | 78.60 | 118.50 | 96.00 | No | 3 days |
| Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup | 78.60 | 118.50 | 96.00 | No | 4 days |
| Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup | 78.60 | 118.50 | 96.00 | No | 5 days |
| Heavy Fire Cleanup | 78.60 | 118.50 | 96.00 | No | 7 days |
| Structural Fire Large Loss | 70.74 | 106.65 | 86.40 | No | 9 days |
| Commercial Fire Large Loss | 70.74 | 106.65 | 86.40 | No | 9 days |

## Notes

- Ranks 1 to 4 share one set of daily rates (78.60, 118.50 and 96.00); the two Large Loss tiers share a lower set (70.74, 106.65 and 86.40).
- The cap is a count of calendar days per job and rises with the tier: 3, 4, 5, 7, 9 and 9.
- Ozone while occupied reads No on every tier.

## Hypothetical day line

Two hypothetical hydroxyl generators running for one day on a Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup job make one day line of 2 units at 118.50, which is 237.00.
